findings.problem: detect-server-roots searches the root and one level down and needs main.py/__init__.py in app/, while the fastapi TDD side finds app at any depth (_split_root): a backend at services/api/app/ or a marker-less app is proposed nothing, check accepts [], and ships under it never arm authz; detect from fastapi.module_root at any depth, or warn when a module_root occurrence in git ls-files sits under no declared root
a gitlink (submodule backend) shows in the diff as the bare path `backend`, which never matches root `backend/app`: a submodule pointer move never arms authz

root case is never compared with git's: on a case-insensitive fs `Backend/app` passes check but never matches git's `backend/app/...`; a doctor check that some git ls-files path equals or sits under each root (byte compare) would close this, m6 and m9's symlink case

roots are project-dir relative but git diff --name-only paths are toplevel relative: a kit installed in a subfolder of its repo never matches a root (pre-existing, more exposed by multi-segment roots); refuse unless show-toplevel is the project dir, or use --relative
